subject: Cutover impact matrix, comms owners & rollback hatch for embedding model phase-out
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Cutover impact matrix, comms owners & rollback hatch for embedding model phase-out

Team —

Quick summary: Acme is on our v1 embeddings endpoint and procurement is asking for a hard date for model removal so they can complete their SOC review. They have ~3M monthly embedding units and a small backlog of historical jobs that still call the legacy model. We need to produce: 1) an impact matrix mapped to customers (who needs changes in SDK, config, or billing); 2) named comms owners for customer outreach; 3) a clear rollback/escape-hatch outline that we can present to procurement and Acme eng.

Asks (short):
- Marissa: can you own the impact matrix and get the first pass for Acme + 3 other top customers by EOD Tuesday? Put the spreadsheet in the shared folder and mark any customers that will need a code change vs a config flip.
- Karthik: we need a proposed customer-facing timeline (cutover windows, opt-in grace period, and forced cutover date) and a short note on routing shims we might offer. Target Wed noon.
- Monica: draft the rollback/escape-hatch doc we can show to procurement. Keep it 1 page + flow diagram. Include who on-call will execute and how we verify fidelity.
- Aditya: pricing and billing impacts — will the deprecation change unit pricing or require credits? Need an initial position.

I'll coordinate with Acme (Sara) once we have the matrix + rollback sketch. I want to avoid ad-hoc exceptions; if an exception is necessary we should list criteria and a TTL.

Attachments: none on this message — I expect rough artifacts in replies.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: 2026-01-16T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cutover impact matrix, comms owners & rollback hatch for embedding model phase-out

Jordan —

First pass attached: acme_impact_matrix_v1.xlsx. I scoped Acme (high priority) + NovaHealth + BrightCart + Maply. Notes:
- Acme: requires a small SDK change for batched embedding calls; engineering estimate 3 dev days for the customer (we can provide a patch/guide). They have historical jobs using the old model; we flagged ~12 backfills that will need re-running.
- NovaHealth: strict HIPAA constraints — will need Private deployment exemption unless they migrate to the new variant; suggest we prepare an exemption checklist.
- BrightCart: config flip only (no SDK changes).
- Maply: not impacted (server-side postprocessing uses embedding IDs, unaffected).

Comms owners recommended: Sara (Acme) -> Jordan (you) + Marissa (technical outreach), NovaHealth -> Monica + Security, BrightCart -> Karthik for product liaison.

I've also added a column for "rollback complexity" and a rough risk score (1-5).

Attachment: acme_impact_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-01-17T09:58:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cutover impact matrix, comms owners & rollback hatch for embedding model phase-out

Thanks Marissa — good first pass. A few operational proposals for the timeline:

- Phase 0 (communication): Week 0 — send targeted notice to impacted customers, open support ticket template, and provide SDK migration guide (we should include a code patch for Acme).
- Phase 1 (opt-in): Weeks 2-4 — customers can opt-in to the new model; we keep routing shim in place (non-realtime path) to reduce cost impact.
- Phase 2 (forced cutover): Week 6 — flip default routing; after 2 weeks of monitoring, remove the legacy model from hosted API.

Rollback / Escape hatch notes:
- Short term: maintain a read-only legacy variant for 14 days post-cutover to allow replays/backfills.
- Emergency: On-call can flip routing back to legacy model for a specified customer for up to 72 hours; this requires sign-off from Product + SLA lead and a postmortem.

I'll draft the customer-facing timeline language and a small appendix explaining routing shims. Also, pricing note for Aditya: any credits should be limited to verified operational loss; avoid blanket credits.

Karthik
Sr. Product Ops

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sara Mills <sara@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@acme.com>
Date: 2026-01-19T15:37:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Cutover impact matrix, comms owners & rollback hatch for embedding model phase-out

Sara / Acme team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround in our internal sync. Attached is the impact matrix Marissa prepared (Acme row highlighted) and a short rollback-hatch outline Monica will finalize tomorrow (rollback-hatch-outline.docx). High-level proposals:

1) Timeline: Notice today, opt-in window 14 days (during which Acme can adopt the new variant), forced cutover in 6 weeks. We will support Acme with an SDK patch and a migration guide — Marissa will be your technical contact.

2) Rollback: We will maintain a legacy-read replica for 14 days post-cutover to allow replays. For critical failures, we will flip routing for Acme for up to 72 hours while we diagnose and remediate. Execution requires signoff from Redwood Product (Jordan) and SLA lead.

3) Procurement ask: We commit to documenting the rollback steps and a clear TTL on exceptions. Aditya, we discussed limiting credits to verified operational loss and not issuing blanket credits; we'll provide a proposed credit policy.

Next steps:
- Marissa: upload final matrix and link in HubSpot record (please include migration checklist).
- Monica: send final rollback outline by EOD tomorrow.
- Aditya: share initial credit position and any carrier/billing constraints by Friday.

Sara — please confirm whether Acme wants a short technical walkthrough next week. We can set up a 30-minute session for Acme engineers.

Best,
Jordan
——
Attachments: acme_impact_matrix_v1.xlsx; rollback-hatch-outline.docx
